variables.name: colour/carbon-bg
variables.description: Ground and surfaces: IBM Carbon's neutral greys. A warm near-black reads as brown next to a sibling app on this palette.

variables.name: colour/toggle-off
variables.description: A switch that is off. On the light ramp surface3 stands too close to a card and to the knob to see, so the track goes down to 3:1 against both.

variables.name: colour/brand-coffee
variables.description: The About card's brand marks at rest, adjusted from the published brand colours. A brand colour is designed against white or its own fill, so on the neutral button ground it fails 3:1 in one theme: #FFDD00 reads 1.14:1 on the light #d1d1d1, and PayPal's navy fails on the dark #525252. Warm brands are deepened for the light theme and dark ones lightened for the dark theme. Contrast: 5.7, 3.3, 3.1 and 7.7 to one on the dark ground, 3.2, 3.2, 8.7 and 11.9 on the light one.

variables.name: colour/brand-android
variables.description: The App tab's marks that are one flat colour or one gradient, at rest. The dark theme lifts a colour a dark tile would swallow; the light theme keeps the brand's own ("Brand tiles").

variables.name: colour/carbon-text
variables.description: Text ramp: three steps, the last still legible at 12px.

variables.name: colour/field-placeholder
variables.description: A field's placeholder. Muted text falls to 2.4:1 on a sub-card's surface3 field, so a placeholder takes the sub step, the dimmest that reads at 4.5:1 on every field fill.

variables.name: colour/accent
variables.description: Activity, and nothing else. Every sibling app opens with this accent, so a fresh install of any of them looks like the same product.

variables.name: colour/status-info-text
variables.description: Four state hues, Carbon's support tones. Paused reuses neutral; its label and its resume control carry the difference.

variables.name: colour/status-warn-bg-strong
variables.description: Opaque, for a chip on a row that already carries a fill the translucent wash would take on.

variables.name: colour/status-warn-bg-soft
variables.description: Quieter, for a paragraph that explains rather than warns, such as the refusal box under "The second way in".

variables.name: colour/glim-scrim
variables.description: The ground behind a floating window, and the blur that takes the page's detail away beneath it.

variables.name: chart/chart-seq-1
variables.description: Sequential, for a heatmap or a density: one blue that gains lightness contrast and colour as the value grows, starting next to the ground.

variables.name: chart/chart-div-1
variables.description: Diverging, for a value above or below a middle: blue under it, orange over it, a near-grey ground colour at the middle itself.
